polls.text: Are you in favor of interim meetings?

chat.author: Jie Dong
chat.text: I have some audio problem

chat.author: Ketan Talaulikar
chat.text: Jie, is it with your mic or speaker or both ?

chat.author: Jie Dong
chat.text: now it is OK

chat.author: Ketan Talaulikar
chat.text: I don't see any lags

chat.author: Ketan Talaulikar
chat.text: This space is moving fast. Fast is in the WG's name :-) I hope everyone in the WG sees the same and the we can do more focused work to expedite without compromising on the technical rigor.

chat.author: Jie Dong
chat.text: Yes lets move fast

chat.author: Carlos Jesús Bernardos
chat.text: @mike: clarification question: you guys are asking to have 3 drafts: PS, requirements and gaps? or 2 drafts: PS and requirements & gaps?

chat.author: Mike McBride
chat.text: Separate requirements draft is the main ask. I personally think we should have separate problem, requirements, gap-analysis, use case drafts.  4 drafts.

chat.author: Mike McBride
chat.text: But again we will figure out how to combine them all into one if that's what the wg decides.

chat.author: Carlos Jesús Bernardos
chat.text: ok, thanks. I personally think splitting this into multiple drafts makes harder to keep to content consistent and adds delay, but we will ask the WG to see what the consensus is

chat.author: Tony Li
chat.text: Network control-lite?

chat.author: Jie Dong
chat.text: should fann notifications be delivered faster than control protocol messages?

chat.author: Tony Li
chat.text: It's not about speed, it's about loss.

chat.author: Tony Li
chat.text: What about CS5, signaling?

chat.author: Jie Dong
chat.text: EF: Expedited Forwarding, which is designed for real-time, latency-sensitive, and interactive voice/telephony services that demand low delay, low jitter, and low packet loss

chat.author: Joel Halpern
chat.text: EF, usually implemented as DB, takes priority over control traffic.  THe description of principles said to avoid that.  Also, EF/DB implementations are typically based on strict admission control,which requires care to match to this use case.

chat.author: Joel Halpern
chat.text: Also, using this for EF/DB could easily break the contract for the data traffic which is using that code point.

chat.author: Pablo Camarillo
chat.text: rotate timeslots!

chat.author: Ketan Talaulikar
chat.text: We can start the asia friendly a little earlier by an hour say ?

chat.author: Tony Li
chat.text: MRC is not of interest.
